rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk1: 'M1 opened with tests-first. M2 added plan push-back... M3 authored the test-strategy skill... M5 built the verifier...' — verified live against sibling module files, not just the maintainer's own claim: getting-going.md L18 'Fix the bug tests-first', plan-mode-done-right.md L19 'Push back twice on the plan', earn-the-trust.md L25 'Author a test-strategy skill through conversation', learn-from-the-test.md L16 'Build a verifier'. Also covered by the file's own recorded consolidation carve-out (backing block: section-3 sweep 2026-07-02, 5 refs judged, 5 carve-out). Chunk1's list item 'loop' (in 'Tests-first, plan push-back, skill, verifier, loop') is common-noun shorthand for 'the eval read' named one sentence earlier in the same chunk ('Two sessions diffed, every gap routed to the check...'), not a proper-noun forward-pointer to the companion closer 'The loop has a name' — no capitalization, no cross-file naming, resolves in-chunk. Chunk2: 'the verifier' resolves to chunk1's list; 'the blind spot' resolves to the two preceding in-chunk sentences about gates not firing on slow-landing costs; 'The countermoves' likewise resolves to the blind-spot problem just named. Chunk3: 'The discipline' resolves either in-chunk (the spec-and-tests theme two sentences up) or to chunk1's 'one quality discipline' (arc-earned, same file); 'that signal' resolves to 'human signal' one sentence earlier in the same chunk. No never-named, vague, or re-chunk-stranded referents found.

Two links, both in chunk2: '[Why software factories fail]' (external, github) and '[Clean Code Is Steering: Reading Uncle Bob's Agent Experiments]' (cross-file, supplementary page) — both named by full title in-sentence with the claim unpacked in the same sentence ('Dex Horthy argues... they learned against checks that answer fast...'; '...carries that story: modularity, architecture visibility, metrics that make decay readable'), not located by position. No 'the opening lecture said' style positional callback anywhere in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk1's M1/M2/M3/M5 claims each verified against the live host-module set (agentic-engineering-101, resolved via site/layouts/curriculum.js MODULES array: M1=getting-going, M2=plan-mode-done-right, M3=earn-the-trust, M5=learn-from-the-test): tests-first (getting-going.md L18, exercise fix-tests-first.md), plan push-back (plan-mode-done-right.md L19, exercise push-back-on-the-plan.md), test-strategy skill (earn-the-trust.md L25, exercise author-test-strategy-skill.md), verifier (learn-from-the-test.md L16). No dead beat. Not the canonical 'the X you did/saw/caught' phrasing (this is training-arc consolidation naming what past modules built, not a callback to the student's own immediately-prior action), but the underlying claim the rule protects — that a referenced beat is live — holds.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal construction anywhere in the file

rules_evaluated.evidence: All three body chunks (1-3) carry multi-sentence standalone paragraphs with a self-carrying claim; none is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet. Chunk 0 is the H1-only title slide, the template's own prior-context exemption.

Closest call is chunk2: 'Decay clears the gate' reads on the idiom 'clears customs/a hurdle' (passes through undetected), matching the body's claim 'No gate fires on any of them, so a session can come back green... still leave the code worse'. Chunk1 header ('Five moves, one quality discipline') is summarized accurately by its own body naming exactly five moves then restating 'Five moves, one discipline'. Chunk3 header ('From spec-and-tests to grounding') matches its body's spec-and-tests description followed by 'The discipline has gone deeper since: grounding.' No header contradicted by its own chunk's content.

No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction anywhere. Chunk3's 'Every push-back, every correction, every "no, like this"' is an anaphora triple whose third leg is a literal quoted exclamation — new concrete content vs. the two abstract nouns before it, clears the third-leg test. No self-grading superlatives (grep for 'most useful'/'one of the'-style value-prop leak: none). No number+retraction ('500K' and 'a million lines' both stand unhedged; the backing block confirms the million-line line is deliberately a rhetorical figure carrying no number-claim, not a retracted measurement). No abstraction-noun stacks — chunk2's three decay examples ('the shortcut cast, the try-catch that swallows an error, the module that grew a second job') are concrete instances, the rule's own recommended fix shape, not a violation. No empty-leg verb triplets anywhere.
rules_evaluated.blocking: self-grading-superlative sub-item only; other sub-items non-blocking per template

'The eval read', 'the verifier', 'the discipline', 'the agentic engineer' are AE101 curriculum vocabulary an engineer in the room can parse, not repo-internal dialect. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture file — headings must be claims, not imperative/phase labels. 'Decay clears the gate' is a full subject-verb-object claim (matches the rule's own 'Gates decay' example). 'Five moves, one quality discipline' and 'From spec-and-tests to grounding' are copula-dropped noun-phrase theses naming their subject, matching the rule's explicit non-violation class 'catalogue entries naming their subject' (cf. 'The numbers', 'Verification, named') rather than bare phase labels or imperatives. No heading instructs an action. Blocking classification: this rule postdates the template's original true/false partition (same gap the template itself flags for rules 9-14); applying the template's own stated principle — blocking = comprehension/trust failure, non-blocking = polish on a working slide — a heading-grammar register question is polish, same class as rule 6, so scored blocking:false here.
